policy: Serve local assets without runtime hotlinks or font CDNs. Product photography is individually identified in data/product-photos.json. Original illustrations and user-supplied 3D assets have separate provenance and are not official Apple geometry.

posters.author: BotZone project
posters.method: Original code-authored SVG illustrations, without imported logos, raster images, meshes or textures.

fonts.author: The Noto Project Authors
fonts.usage: Local web font and reusable Vietnamese-capable export font

colorReferences.name: Burgundy
colorReferences.method: Manually selected representative UI color based on the BA product color direction; not extracted from calibrated official photography and not an official Apple HEX.

colorReferences.name: Băng Thanh / Ice
colorReferences.method: Manually selected representative Pro-series cool accent. The Duo screen illustration uses #789ca9 and #b2cbd1; these are screen artwork colors, not Duo body colors. Official Duo page lists Trời Đêm and Trắng Ánh Sao.

colorReferences.name: Duo neutral bodies
colorReferences.method: Representative light and dark neutral materials for the official Trắng Ánh Sao and Trời Đêm names, verified on 2026-11-13. Not calibrated or official HEX values.

productionNotes.blender: No Blender session was available in the tool catalogue; parent agent localhost:9876 probe failed. These meshes were authored and exported with Three.js, not Blender. No claim of Blender validation is made.
productionNotes.limitations: Simplified geometric illustrations. Exact device dimensions, official appearance and material color remain unverified. The preserved generator permits replacing the geometry after a permitted source/model review.
productionNotes.dependencyLicenses: Three.js and GLTFExporter: MIT. React Three Fiber, Drei and GSAP are package dependencies; their package licenses remain in node_modules/package metadata. No external decoder CDN is used.
productionNotes.scope: Legacy original illustration GLBs only. Supplied Blender v003 package has separate provenance below.

productPhotography.source: Official Apple product, store, support and newsroom pages recorded for every asset
productPhotography.copyright: Apple Inc.; no open or blanket redistribution license is asserted. Bundled for the user-requested local educational demo.

catalogueSpecifications.note: Official Apple technical data summarized in VI/EN. Unverified fields are omitted; manufacturer options are separate from shop SKUs. Imported through the existing C# backend into products.specs without a migration.
